findings.summary: The guest portal main region is auto-placed in the authenticated shell navigation column.
findings.reproduction: Open /portal/login at an ordinary desktop width without a portal session.

findings.summary: The Business Security navigation contribution references an icon absent from the administrator sprite.
findings.reproduction: Render the core administrator navigation and resolve kumwe-icon-security.

findings.summary: The fixed shell, catalog and nested editor grids exceed the usable content width and clip definition controls.
findings.reproduction: Open a populated definition at 1616 by 1031 or 1280 by 800 and inspect element bounding boxes.

findings.summary: Browse, create, edit, policy, approval and credential tasks are combined into single overwhelming pages.
findings.reproduction: Count competing forms, tables, disclosures, headings and primary actions in the first viewport and full page.

findings.summary: Current browser checks can pass document-level overflow while individual components clip, overlap or escape containers.
findings.reproduction: Compare document scrollWidth with affected panel and control bounding boxes on the populated definition fixture.

findings.summary: The ordinary portal-user provisioning path and demonstration data prerequisites are not discoverable as one journey.
findings.reproduction: Starting from Users and Access, attempt to provision and sign in a minimum-authority portal member without documentation search.
